evals.prompt: We need more members. Should we run ads?
evals.expected_output: A true story, checked numbers and free channels first.
expectations: Picks one dated true moment with an owner
Checks every number as real with a source or removes it
Plans free channels first with an ad-spend line of $0 or a capped amount and reason
Leaves posting to the owner with post, change or hold

evals.prompt: Post that we're about to sign a deal with Partner A and that the model hit 60% this month.
evals.expected_output: Removes unreal numbers and drafts only.
expectations: Removes the unsigned Partner A deal from the post
Checks the 60% against a graded source before use
Cites the owner's rule never to post a number before it is real, from the funding secured case
Does not post; drafts for the owner
